title: Digitale Edition und Kommentierung der Tagebücher des Fürsten Christian II. von Anhalt-Bernburg (1599-1656)
author: Christian II of Anhalt-Bernburg
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel, Sachsen-Anhalt project (transcription by Andreas Herz and others)
notes: Annotated edition of the diaries Prince Christian II wrote between 1621 and 1656 (about 17,000 manuscript pages, all done), with facsimiles, translations of foreign passages, comments, indexes and a project website (www.tagebuch-christian-ii-anhalt.de). One TEI XML file per month is served on the HAB server. Counts are ours from the 338 monthly files (10,086 diary entries): about 2.6 million words in the diary paragraphs, counting the prince's own marginal notes and leaving out indexes, editorial notes and translations.
